heading: Reggindorɗe baawɗe tappirde
try_different_search_or_create: Enndu helmere njiylawu woɗnde walla sos regginorde hesere nde waawi tappeede.
slug_taken_error: Ooɗoo slug ina huutoree tawo. Eɗen ñaagii nde cuɓoto-ɗaa heen goɗɗo.
share_slug_missing_tooltip: Set slug renndinde e nder Kabaaru kuuɓtodinɗo hade renndinde
delete_directory_description: Aɗa sikki aɗa yiɗi momtude ndee regginorde tappirde? Ngolɗoo gollal waawaa ustaade.
load_error: Waawaa loowde regginorde. Tiiɗno, hesɗitin, ƴeewto kadi.
cover_image_description: Neldu natal jokkorgal yeeso ngam lomtaade hello jokkorgal tiitoonde/siftorde, e natal jokkorgal caggal ngam ɓeydude hello udditirngo. So tawii natal alaa, regginorde ndee huutortoo ko jokkorgal binndol ngol.
image_too_large: Natal ngal ina foti ɓurde 10MB famɗude
layout_reorder_hint: Ɓoɗɗu + ngam ɓeydude huunde e laylaytol. Huutoro ƴiye ngam yuɓɓinde geɗe cuɓaaɗe.
query_param_overrides_default_location: Ooɗoo parameeter naamnal ina fooɗa konfiguraasiyoŋ nokkuure gonnde
no_sources: Ndee feccere alaa iwdi tawo. Yah to njeñtudi njiylawu walla doggol ɓurngol yiɗeede, resndu ɗum ɗoo.
public_preview_ready: Sosde maa ina foti fuɗɗaade ɗoon e ɗoon.
public_preview_error: Won ko ŋakki e feewnude ndeeɗoo PDF.
share_dialog_description: Suɓo mbaadi ndi keɓooɓe ɓee njiyata, caggal ɗuum ƴettu jokkorde ndee.
wizard_step2_description: Yiylo ko taƴre adannde ndee foti limtude, cuɓo-ɗaa nokku ɗo regginorde ndee huutortoo. Aɗa waawi ɓeydude taƴe goɗɗe e waylude nokku oo caggal.
wizard_query_help: Cuɓal — aɗa waawi kadi ɓeydude ɗum caggal gila e hello regginorde.
share_url_help: Kala jogiiɗo ndee jokkorde ina waawi ƴettude PDF. Waylude ɗum ina taƴa jokkorɗe ɗe ndenndu-ɗaa.

access_policy_description.private: Ko aan tan waawi udditaade e waylude ɗum ɗoo.
access_policy_description.shared_read: Huutortooɓe woɗɓe jogiiɓe mbaawka heɓde regginorde tappirde ina mbaawi udditaade ɗum ; ko aan tan waawi waylude ɗum.
access_policy_description.shared_edit: Huutortooɓe woɗɓe jogiiɓe mbaawka heɓde regginorde tappirde ina mbaawi udditaade e waylude ɗum.

capability_required: Konte maa ngalaa heen ngalɗoo gollal.

localized_field.auto_translate_hint: Ɗemɗe meere ina pirtee otomatik so a hisnii. Firooji baylaaɗi ina keɓee.

languages_help: Ɗemɗe ɗe ndee regginorde firtetee, ina waawi tappeede walla renndineede.
wizard_location_help: Huutortee ko kala taƴre nde ƴettataa nokku mum.
unable_to_add_source: Regginorde ndee sosaa, kono naamnal mum waawaa ɓeydeede. Aɗa waawi ɓeydude ɗum gila e hello regginorde.
logo_help: Tappirde kala ɗo laylaytol hoore walla les ina waɗi Logo. So gooto alaa, logo lowre ndee huutortee.
scheduled_delivery_description: Neldu PDF ndee regginorde otomatikk e ñalɗi ɗi cuɓ-ɗaa ɗii. Deliveries njalta ko hedde waktu 3ɓo subaka waktu fuɗnaange.
scheduled_delivery_empty: Alaa ko jogori arde tawo. Ɓeydu heen limre ngam neldude PDF oo e iimeel e ñalɗi cuɓaaɗi e nder yontere walla lewru.

scheduled_delivery_last_run_skipped: Sokkii e {{date}}: tagɗo ɗum nattii waawde yuɓɓinde jokkondire
scheduled_delivery_locale_removed: Ngal ɗemngal ittaama e regginorde, ko ɗum waɗi ngal neldetee ko e {{language}}.
scheduled_delivery_test_failed: Waawaa neldude iimeel jarriborɗo oo. Tiiɗno enndu kadi.
scheduled_delivery_delete_description: Heɓooɓe ɗum ɓee maa ngoppu heɓde ndeeɗoo PDF.
scheduled_delivery_save_failed: Waawaa hisnude doggol ngol. Tiiɗno enndu kadi.
scheduled_delivery_limit_reached: Ooɗoo regginorde ina jogii tawo {{max}} limlebbi, ɓurɗo heewde.

scheduled_delivery_days_required: Suɓo ko famɗi fof ñalawma gooto.

scheduled_delivery_email_footer: Aɗa heɓa ɗum sabu {{email}} yuɓɓinii ndee neldude. Jaabo ndee iimeel ngam jokkondirde e maɓɓe.

scheduled_delivery_recipients_help: Seerndu adreesuuji ɗii e kommaaji walla diidi kesi. Jaɓɓotooɓe ɓee mbaawaa yiyde adresuuji mum en.
scheduled_delivery_dialog_description: Suɓo nde PDF neldatee, hol mbaydi, e hol keɓoowo ɗum.

scheduled_delivery_reason_empty: Reggindo ngoo alaa kaɓirɗe, ko ɗum waɗi alaa ko neldata. Ɓeydu taƴe walla njuɓɓin naamne mum en.
